page.content:
Scott's Los Angeles 2019 film.

How Blade Runner (1982) connects

  • Creator: Ridley Scott — Ridley Scott directed Blade Runner (1982).
  • Topic: Blade Runner — The 1982 film is the central Blade Runner work.
  • Character: Rick Deckard — The 1982 film is Deckard's hunt through Los Angeles 2019.
  • Work: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? — The novel was adapted into Blade Runner (1982).
  • Work: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? — The 1982 film is adapted from Dick's novel.
  • Character: Roy Batty — Roy Batty is the Nexus-6 leader of the 1982 film.
  • Location: Los Angeles 2019 — The 1982 film is set in Los Angeles 2019.
  • Creator: Hampton Fancher — Hampton Fancher wrote key drafts of the 1982 film.
  • Character: Rachael — Rachael's test and flight are central to 1982.
  • Work: Blade Runner 2049 — 2049 follows decades after the 1982 film.

What is Blade Runner (1982)?

Blade Runner (1982) sends Deckard after Roy Batty's Nexus-6 group, through Tyrell's pyramid, Rachael's test, and the rain of a dying city.

Key threads lead to Ridley Scott, Blade Runner, Rick Deckard, Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?, Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep? and Roy Batty.
